description_zh: 本接口用于停止旁路推流任务
kebab_example: aliyun rtc stop-streaming-out --app-id eo850000 --channel-id testid --task-id 123 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopStreamingOut

parameters.help_en: The application ID, which is created and queried via the console. Only a single ID is supported.
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: An existing channel ID. Only a single ID is supported.
parameters.help_zh: 已存在的频道ID，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of an existing bypass stream ingest job. Only a single ID is supported. It can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens (-), with a maximum length of 55 bytes. If not specified, the system will automatically generate one.
parameters.help_zh: 已存在的旁路推流的任务ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大55字节。不填，则由系统自动生成
parameters.name: task_id

v1_parameters.help_en: The application ID, which is created and queried via the console. Only a single ID is supported

v1_parameters.name: AppId
